blocks.text: Longtime celebrity couple Michelle Vito and Enzo Pineda are officially taking the next step in their journey, taking to social media to announce their engagement after six years together. The couple shared the milestone on Tuesday through a series of dreamy photos captured by Nice Print Photography, showing Pineda on one knee during an intimate outdoor proposal in a scenic garden adorned with a purple floral arch on October 28.
